access: restricted during peer review; metadata and DOI are public, files are released on request via the Zenodo landing page
immutability: a PUBLISHED Zenodo record is immutable: its files cannot be replaced without minting a new version DOI. This is why it is cited alongside the GitHub release, which is versioned but mutable.
verifying_without_file_access: Every archived file is derived from the pinned commit or from the identically named GitHub release asset, so correspondence can be confirmed by regenerating the archive and comparing SHA-256 -- no Zenodo download required. Verified reproducible on 2026-08-28 for the repository archive, byte-identical both compressed and uncompressed.
